**Which family of figures would you template?**
(e.g. "Fourier series with N harmonics", "slope field for ODE
dy/dx = f(x,y)", "vector addition head-to-tail")

**What's the typical user prompt?**
(2-3 example prompts that should hit this template.)

**Sketch the output**
(If you can, paste a hand-drawn screenshot or an example from a
textbook. The clearer the target visual, the easier to implement.)

**What structured arguments would the template take?**
(e.g. for "Fourier series": `{"function": "sawtooth", "harmonics": 5,
"period": 1}`.)

**Are you willing to implement it?**
- [ ] Yes, I'll send a PR (see CONTRIBUTING.md for the pattern in
      `studio/templates/matrix.py`)
- [ ] No, just suggesting
